items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Lionel Hampton, played with Lionel Hampton, Allen Barry (phonetic).

ctx.x: Lionel Hampton, played with Lionel Hampton, Allen Barry (phonetic). Kind of light complected boy, very nice looking boy, had that old drinking look though.
That old drinking look, and he went out to the West Coast and then they brought him to Chicago.
